r6-asia-investor-gaps.notes: Job 1 (script defect): processed all 218 greater-china/taiwan rows in investor-roster.tsv systematically via char-level simplified<->traditional conversion (OpenCC s2t/t2s), cross-checked against each record's existing name.local + aka set. 203 rows were missing the other script's form and got a script_fix; 1 row (cn-lyfe-capital) already carries both 洲嶺资本/洲岭资本; 5 rows use only script-neutral characters (no fix needed, e.g. 阿里健康, 薄荷天使基金); 9 rows have no Chinese name/aka at all.
